subject: The dangerous weight loss myth 90% of dog owners believe
preview_text: You're probably making this exact mistake right now. Here's what the research actually shows about dog nutrition.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For years, I thought cutting my dog's food portions in half was the fastest way to help him lose weight. Turns out I was starving him while making his body cling to every calorie. And if you're doing what most owners do—just reducing kibble—you're making the same dangerous mistake.

Here's the truth everyone gets wrong: Dogs don't just need less food. They need different food. When you slash portions without adjusting nutrients, you trigger survival mode where their metabolism slows and fat storage increases. The real solution? Strategic protein increases with controlled carbs. I've seen dogs lose 3x more weight on the same calories just by shifting the nutrient balance. The research is clear—it's not about quantity, it's about composition.

This is exactly why PupShape's custom meal plans aren't just calorie calculators. They're nutrient balancers that adjust protein, fat, and carb ratios based on your dog's specific metabolism. The algorithm uses vet-approved guidelines to create meals that satisfy hunger while telling your dog's body 'it's safe to burn fat now.'

Open the app right now and check your dog's current meal plan. Tap 'Adjust Plan' and see how the nutrient ratios change when you input different activity levels. You'll notice the calories might stay similar while the food composition shifts dramatically. That's the secret. P.S. The dogs losing 15% in 8 weeks? They're all on these balanced ratios—not starvation diets.
